newsitem.title: EGYPT: Cairo Precision Industries offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Cairo Precision Industries offer oversubscribed.

text.p: An offer of shares in Egyptian water heater maker Cairo Precision Industries was more than 10 times oversubscribed, an official of the agents said on Sunday.
The offer, of 300,000 new shares at a fixed price of 85.00 pounds ($25) a share, has closed after the statutory minimum period of 10 days, he added.
Cairo Precision, is one of the first Egyptian so-called "closed" companies to open up to the public through a share issue on the stock exchange.

The spokesman, at Commercial International Investment Company, said the shares would be allocated to applicants pro rata and the transactions would probably go through the stock exchange next Thursday or Sunday.
The share issue cuts the stake of the parent company, family firm Olympic Electric, to about 52 percent from 62 percent.
Other parties, including mutual funds and banks, previously held about 570,000 of the original 1.5 million shares.

Cairo Precision has forecast that its net after-tax profits will increase to 19.046 million pounds in 1997 from 15.931 million in 1996. A group official said earlier last month that profits were 14.755 million in 1995.
